channel.title: trez63 — one small app a day
channel.description: Every day ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Muse each build a single-page app from the same one-line prompt. Play them, vote for the winner.

item.title: Sieve (Claude)
item.description: Paste raw log lines in any format and it clusters them into message templates with the variable parts marked as slots, so thousands of lines collapse to a short list you can filter by level and sort by frequency. Drag across the timeline to see which templates spike or first appear in that window; tap one for its slot values, sample lines and a ready-made regex; export templates as CSV.

item.title: CanvasForge (Grok)
item.description: A Business Model Canvas you fill in block by block. Add, edit and remove items across the nine blocks, watch the completeness score climb, and it writes a one-paragraph pitch from your segments, value propositions and revenue streams. Save and reopen as JSON.

item.title: Rail (Claude)
item.description: Type a regular expression and it draws it as a railroad diagram you can read left to right. Paste test text to see every match highlighted, tap any box in the diagram to see which characters that part captured, read a plain-English breakdown, and preview a replacement live.

item.title: CipherVault (Gemini)
item.description: A small vault for secrets that never leaves the browser. Type a master passphrase, add named API keys, database credentials or tokens, and each is encrypted with AES-GCM; clear or change the passphrase and they turn back into ciphertext. Includes a high-entropy key generator and saves the encrypted vault as JSON.

item.title: DocuForge (Gemini)
item.description: Lay out a one-page document on a canvas: drag text blocks into place, edit their text and size, fill in template variables like client, invoice number and total that substitute into any block that references them, then print it to PDF. Save the layout as JSON.

item.title: Launchstamp (ChatGPT)
item.description: Enter one destination URL and a campaign name, add a placement for each place the link will appear (newsletter, social post, partner email), and it builds the UTM-tagged URL for every placement, shows the anatomy of each, flags two placements that would produce the same link, and copies or exports the set as a launch sheet.

item.title: Next Touch (ChatGPT)
item.description: A small follow-up desk: add the people you want to stay in touch with, give each a next action and a date, and it sorts them into due, later and undated. After you talk to someone, log the touch with a note and pick the next step; the history stays with that person. Save and reopen as JSON.

item.title: Outline Builder (Muse)
item.description: Pick a template (consulting proposal, statement of work or project brief), tick sections on or off, rename and reorder them or add your own, and it writes a numbered outline in a live preview you can copy or download as Markdown, text or JSON.

item.title: Phish Spotter (Muse)
item.description: A deck of fourteen made-up emails, texts and chat messages. Swipe or press a button to call each one phish or legit, and after every verdict it tells you the tells you should have spotted (lookalike domains, urgency, odd requests) and keeps your score and streak.

item.title: Veil (Claude)
item.description: Paste text with secrets or personal details in it, and every key, token, card number, email, IP, phone and name you list is swapped for a consistent placeholder so you can share it safely. Paste the reply back and Restore puts the originals in. Toggle categories with a click; save the session as JSON.

item.title: Crux (Claude)
item.description: Type a project plan one task per line with optimistic-likely-pessimistic durations and dependencies, and it draws the Gantt chart, marks the critical path, and simulates the schedule thousands of times to show how likely each finish date really is. Tap a task for its float and risk; save or reopen plans as JSON.

item.title: DealForge (Grok)
item.description: A sales pipeline board: drag deal cards between stages from lead to closed, click one to edit its value, probability, close date and next action, and watch the total and probability-weighted forecast update. Search filters the board; save or open the pipeline as JSON.

item.title: Prism (Claude)
item.description: Paste any SQL and it parses it in the browser and shows the query's shape from seven angles: a dataflow diagram, join fan-out analysis, WHERE and CASE logic as trees, execution steps in order, column lineage, lint findings with one-click fixes, and a clause outline. Format or transform the query, then save the session as JSON.

item.title: Logglass (ChatGPT)
item.description: Paste or open an application log and it parses each line's level, timestamp and message, counts severities, maps where the noise clusters along the file, and groups recurring messages into patterns. Filter by level, text or region, pin the useful lines, add notes, and copy a brief for a handoff; save or reopen the investigation as JSON.

item.title: Meeting Meter (Muse)
item.description: Set attendees, hourly cost and planned length with three sliders, then start the timer and watch the running cost of the meeting climb by the second. Presets for standups and all-hands; save or reload the setup as JSON.

item.title: KanbanFlow (Gemini)
item.description: A deal pipeline board. Drag cards between Lead, Contacted, Proposal, Negotiation and Won; each deal carries a value and win probability, and the bar on top keeps total, weighted forecast and won value current. Save and reopen the board as JSON.

item.title: Revision Room (ChatGPT)
item.description: Paste a before and after draft and compare them: a word-level redline shows what was removed and added, with counts and next/previous jumps between changes. Swap drafts, copy the notes, or save the session as JSON.

item.title: ChromaWave (Gemini)
item.description: A synthesizer in the browser. Play the keys A to K, pick a waveform, turn the filter and delay knobs, and watch the waveform draw itself as it sounds.

item.title: Orrery (Claude)
item.description: The solar system from above and the sky overhead, computed from orbital elements. Scrub time forward or back, pick a city, and click any body for its position, phase and rise and set times.

item.title: Tidy Text (Muse)
item.description: Paste messy copied text and clean copy appears beside it. Toggle the rules: join wrapped lines, collapse blanks, fix double spaces, straighten quotes. Copy or download the result.

item.title: TurtleLoom (Grok)
item.description: Turtle graphics with live sliders. Drag repeats, sides, turn step and hue and the pattern redraws as you go; edit the generated commands to go further, then save a PNG.

item.title: Backplan (ChatGPT)
item.description: Plan backward from a deadline. Set the finish time, list the steps with their minutes and prerequisites, and it works out the latest you can start and which steps have no slack.

item.title: Carve (Claude)
item.description: Content-aware image resizing. Drag an edge and the picture shrinks by removing its least interesting paths, so subjects stay intact. Paint over an object and delete it.

item.title: Budget (Muse)
item.description: Projected income and expenses on one page, offline. Enter anything weekly, monthly or yearly and it normalizes to a monthly view.

item.title: Hilbert (Claude)
item.description: See the shape of any file. Every byte is laid along a Hilbert curve, so headers, text, compressed streams and padding each get their own texture.

item.title: Tessera (Claude)
item.description: An Escher-style tiling editor. Shape one tile and the plane re-tiles itself with no gaps or overlaps.

item.title: Chroma Desk (ChatGPT)
item.description: A small studio for everyday color. Drop a photo, pull a palette out of it, then edit and export the swatches.

item.title: Dayblock (Muse)
item.description: A time-block day planner. Drag on the timeline to carve out your day; overlaps are allowed and the totals just add up.

item.title: Pantry Clock (Muse)
item.description: What's expiring first? Track what's in the fridge, freezer and pantry and tap an item to use it up before it becomes waste.

item.title: Aether (Grok)
item.description: A cosmic particle weaver. Move the mouse to weave, click to plant a star, scroll to change the force; attract, orbit, chaos and paint modes.

item.title: PulseForge (Grok)
item.description: An offline step sequencer. Eight tracks from kick to pad, click steps to toggle notes, tempo and randomize on the keyboard. Pure Web Audio.

item.title: Cosmic Breath (Gemini)
item.description: A slow particle field that breathes. Click to begin, move the cursor to bend its gravity, and let it set your pace.

item.title: Ledger (Muse)
item.description: Your money on one page, offline. Add an entry and the totals, chart and list update at once. Nothing leaves the browser.

item.title: Meadowsong (Muse)
item.description: A wind-chime meadow you play by gliding your cursor through it.

item.title: Position (Claude)
item.description: Press or fold — nothing in between. Six crude signals decide whether you have position in a deal, so there is nothing to interpret in the moment.

item.title: Crosslight (ChatGPT)
item.description: A mirror puzzle. Turn the mirrors so every beam reaches its receiver — a small game that rewards a second look.

item.title: Kaleido (Muse)
item.description: Draw once, see it eight times. Every stroke mirrors around the centre into a mandala.

item.title: Sonogram (Claude)
item.description: Draw a picture; hear it. The canvas is a spectrogram — left to right is time, bottom to top is pitch.

item.title: Tradeoff (ChatGPT)
item.description: Make room for what matters. Rate your options, weigh your priorities, and see the smallest shift that would change your mind.

item.title: Foldwork (ChatGPT)
item.description: A tiny paper studio. Size an envelope, add a name and a message, print the template and fold it into something real.

item.title: Genesis (Muse)
item.description: Type anything and it becomes a universe. The same words always produce the same universe, on any machine.

item.title: Reckon (Claude)
item.description: A notepad that does math. Write naturally; numbers, units, dates and variables compute in the margin.

item.title: Ripple (Claude)
item.description: A wave tank you can draw in. Walls reflect, glass refracts, and the whole wave equation is ten lines of code.

item.title: Sprout (Muse)
item.description: A tiny garden you grow by clicking. Every plant is different; rain makes them grow faster.

item.title: Stillpoint (ChatGPT)
item.description: A little space to focus. Plant a star, shape a soundscape, make room for one thing.

item.title: Label sheets (Claude)
item.description: Paste a list of names, pick a label size and paper, and print a sheet where every name is set as large as it fits.
